en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a large spa or resort complex with ornate cast‑iron colonnades and a domed pavilion in the foreground, attached to a multi‑storey neoclassical building with mansard roof and dormer windows. Another classical facade with arched windows stands to the left, in front of a wooded hillside with a tower or castle ruin on the slope. Well‑kept flowerbeds and paths occupy the foreground, with several people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century dress walking or working in the garden. The architecture strongly suggests a Central European spa town.
